venues.name: CC Atlanta
venues.narrative: **CCATL — Monday 8/31.** Slow Monday; the "pop" came early in the day and it quieted as the night went on. Opener completed cleaning duties and closer ran a proactive close while tending to late guests. BOH had great ticket times, completed cleaning and defrosted chicken wings — hit the food sales target ($252). Comps $29.10 (community/investor $2.90, emp 50% $14.00, industry $12.20). 86'd: Ocho reposado, bubbles (liquor order arrives tomorrow). Maintenance: 3rd door handle needs replacement (~$60, handyman this week). Favorite moment: neighborhood regulars in early for Meal Deals, popular with nearby residential buildings. Entered by MKZ.

venues.name: CC Nashville
venues.narrative: **CCNSH — Monday 8/31.** Chill, smooth Monday night — slow start, picked up consistently from ~8:45pm with several 8+ groups and industry friends old and new; peak 9:30–10:30pm, bar empty by 11:30pm. Comps $24.50 / 1.8% (employee, F&F, industry). Danny held down the kitchen. Maintenance: keg cooler CO2 (potential solve in works). Favorite moment: a young couple celebrating a 21st birthday loved the Wild Strawberry Daiquiri and TK Mule. Entered by BC.

venues.name: D&C Denver
venues.narrative: **DVR — Monday 8/31.** DC/AM $340.42; D&C (PM) $4,507.30; no garden/6A. "Slowest day I've ever seen" per PM notes — bar prep done by 3:30pm, opening server cut before 7pm, mid and host cut by 10pm. Morning was super chill with IRD love and DCAM menu/tea-drink training; drawer $2 short (rounding convo had). Kitchen: great night, decent late pop, Fiellah killing it; several lows (lime crumble, cola dip, hot honey, fingerlings, etc.), 911 on chantilly/scallop/pasta dough, nothing 86'd. Snacks Only Menu rolls out tomorrow — need iPad menu-slot access confirmed with AMG. Favorite moment: birthday celebrations. Entered by MJH.

venues.name: D&C East Village
venues.narrative: **EV — Monday 8/31.** Slow, quiet Monday with alternating bar/floor flows — bar filled, emptied as the floor filled, lulled, then a bar resurgence before quieting. Mostly duos ("duo megalopolis"), only four 3-tops; nearly full at 8:15pm, emptying from 9pm with bursts after 10pm. Retail $66. 89 covers, 6 solos, no large parties or investor cocktails. Top sellers: Rosalie; High Plains Drifter / Burner Phone / Paper Wasp (tie). Cheers to a 35th-anniversary couple; welcomed EV's own Ella and Nordic bar owners from the Hudson Valley. No no-shows; a few cancellations due to limited food menu. Breakage: 1 chipped egg coupe. Maintenance: mice loud in the kitchen. Entered by Thomas.

venues.name: D&C Los Angeles
venues.narrative: **LA — Monday 8/31.** Started slow, picked up around dinner and stayed consistent — a solid one-server shift. Oyster Monday momentum building: birthday party for neighbors from Wursku (hot dog place next door), and a two-guest birthday that put down 24 oysters. Food and cocktails flew out at a steady pace. Comps $279.30 (regulars + large comp for Wursku neighbors). Josh's first day as kitchen lead — cleaning oysters and keeping the team stocked. 86'd: Hendricks, shrimp toast. No maintenance needs. Entered by Julian.

venues.name: D&C Washington DC
venues.narrative: **DC — Monday 8/31.** Another quiet Monday — the room filled a bit at times but never kicked off. Team used downtime to ABK the space; a few return guests / hopefully new regulars, and late-night tables kept things occupied to the end. 62 guests (13 Resy, 49 walk-ins). Comps $120.94 / 5.5% (investor, employee discounts); no voids. Very quiet kitchen — Rasaan and Marcus knocked out inventory. Went well: communication, ABK, guest connection; improve: water service, bathroom checks. Maintenance: garbage disposal; ice machine slightly better but still leaking; rodents. Favorite moment: Ben as ABK King and Connor celebrating his birthday. Entered by Jesse.

venues.name: Municipal Grand F&B
venues.weather: A bit gloomy to start, cleared up by the afternoon
venues.narrative: **MG — Monday 8/31.** Net $2,340 vs $3,000 target (-22%). Municipal Bar AM $338 (5 guests, Sam MOD); PM $1,904 (55 guests, Justin & Marcus); Sun Club $98; Hot Eye $0. Food $1,068; events $0; comps $54.70. Slow morning — Tia held it solo, Madeleine trained on opening but left early. Evening: Eva and Sierra on the floor, one bartender with Kaylee barbacking; a second bartender knocked out inventory during the slow day. Good pop at 9pm — near-full bar and all 40s sat 9–10, then everyone left by 10:30; very early night. Sun Club: lazy day, 2 customers, 2 frozens. Kitchen: low on caviar — ordered from WCW pending Paramount switch; no AM prep person so line needs to prep green goddess. No injuries/incidents. Favorite moment: Kaylee shaking an espresso martini for a bar guest. Entered by Justin (submitted a day late, 9:39am 9/1).
